training.architecture: hashed word/character n-grams + linear softmax, int8 weights
training.provenance: Assistant-authored Japanese examples: 150 base phrases, three training-only variants each. No external teacher API. Japanese calibration and exam authored separately and frozen before training. Same architecture/settings as the English baseline. Single-intent refund/support/sales routing; ambiguous, mixed-intent and out-of-scope requests should abstain.

calibration.note: Thresholds selected on this small authored calibration set; not a statistical safety guarantee.
